name: Fake app traffic caps and admin kill switch
target: Per-app request and response byte accounting with warning, throttle, block, window reset, and immediate admin stream termination
inputs: app slug and request/response byte counts
accounting window and ordered traffic thresholds
observations: per-app byte totals and warning/throttle/block decisions
window reset restores the app traffic allowance
admin block rejects new requests and closes active streams
neighbor apps remain unaffected; ledger stores byte counts and status only
